subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub preserve a supported no-republish GitHub Release recovery path when npm publication succeeds but release creation fails?
rationale: CI cannot decide whether this operational fallback is intentionally required; current main documents it as part of the release contract and the proposed replacement cannot handle the same state.

options.title: Preserve or replace recovery
options.body: Keep the current workflow or add an equivalent tested repair-only mode before deleting it.

options.title: Accept manual recovery
options.body: Retire the workflow only with explicit release-owner approval and a documented, least-privilege manual recovery procedure.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Leave the current automation unchanged if the team does not want to own a new recovery mechanism now.

recommendation.title: Preserve or replace recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the current workflow or add an equivalent tested repair-only mode before deleting it.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick introduced and recently maintained the paired release workflows and deploy runbook, making him the strongest individual history owner for this decision.
